text: ポケモンリーグへ　いどむ　きみへ　せんべつだ！

structure.jp: ポケモンリーグへ　いどむ　きみへ
structure.en: to you, who challenge the Pokémon League

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: ポケモンリーグへ　いどむ　きみ
patterns.explanation: A phrase ending in a verb placed right before a person describes that person. ポケモンリーグへ　いどむ　きみ = 'you, who are going to challenge the Pokémon League'
